title: Read and build workspace addresses
responsibility: Recognizes workspace addresses, reads their project and revision selection, and builds links to catalog entries and their sections.

inputs.name: isWorkspacePath.path
inputs.description: The path to check for a /harness address or a /projects/{project}/harness address. This recognition step does not validate the category or commit.

inputs.name: workspaceRoute.path
inputs.description: The workspace path to read, optionally naming a project, encoded branch, commit, category, entity and section. A named commit must contain exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The category defaults to pages when absent.

inputs.name: workspacePath.target
inputs.description: The category to link to, plus optional project, branch, commit, entity and section. Project, branch and entity names are URL-encoded. A section is included only when an entity is supplied. This builder does not validate a supplied commit.

outputs.name: routeSuffixes
outputs.description: The recognized entity sections: designs, plan, used-in, uses, relationships, evidence, history and details. Relationships remains accepted as an older address. An overview has no section suffix.

outputs.name: isWorkspacePath
outputs.description: True when the path has a recognized workspace prefix, otherwise false. A true result alone does not mean the full path can be read successfully.

outputs.name: workspaceRoute
outputs.description: The decoded project, branch and entity, the commit, category and recognized section. Missing selections are null, except the default pages category. An unknown section is treated as no section.

outputs.name: workspacePath
outputs.description: A workspace path carrying the supplied selections. A missing project creates a legacy /harness link; absent branch and commit leave the revision unspecified.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Reading fails for a non-workspace address, a commit other than a full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal hash, or an unknown catalog category. Invalid URL escapes in decoded names can also throw; recognition can encounter that decoding error for project names.
